$comment: Pinned library versions. Every lesson must load exactly these. Upgrading is a deliberate change: update this file, update every lesson that uses the library, and re-test them. scripts/validate-projects.mjs enforces it.

three.$comment: three.module.min.js imports ./three.core.js (unminified, about 1.46 MB). Every import map must also map https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.186.1/build/three.core.js to three.core.min.js.

npm.$comment: Pinned npm package versions for lesson server code (package.json 'dependencies'/'devDependencies'). Every lesson's package.json must depend on exactly these version strings, with no ^ or ~ range — scripts/validate-projects.mjs enforces it. Upgrading is a deliberate change: update this file, update every lesson's package.json that uses the package, and re-test them.
